notices.summary: Five-agent control plane initialized; no runtime changes on integration branch before branch creation and owner review.
All five isolated agent branches were created from the same planning head. First independent steps are released; integration branch remains owner-only.

events.summary: Catalog-native domain types and contract overrides
requiredActions: Read every production path and agent block
Stay inside owned paths
Append an event with every implementation commit

events.summary: Frozen catalog-native product, unit-evidence, status, diagnostics and failure exports without transport or legacy API aliases.
requiredActions: Forge projects verified SQLite rows into CatalogProduct and preserves CatalogSearchHit resultIndex order
Helix consumes CatalogUnitEvidence only when provenUnit is present and returns calibration when countable weight is absent
Lumen renders CatalogStatus and redacted CatalogDiagnostics with immediate retry
Sentinel enforces that catalog domain imports no transport, React, SQLite or legacy API types

events.summary: Replaced API/cache compatibility contracts with one verified catalog authority, catalog-native diagnostics, hard credential retirement and non-mocked contract tests.
requiredActions: All agents treat catalog and clinic as the only source modes; api is not a compatibility alias
Forge emits CatalogFailure and CatalogDiagnostics and never exposes legacy network/cache diagnostics
Helix reads only CatalogProduct and CatalogUnitEvidence, with generic consensus gated by explicit user authorization
Lumen removes OFF credentials, gateway fields and online product settings instead of migrating them
Sentinel validates zero product-network requests, real SQLite-WASM/OPFS execution, no mocks, no CSS concealment and no source transformer
Owner may delete legacy files only after replacement integration and import scan

events.summary: CatalogFailure now removes credential-shaped keys and redacts bearer tokens and secret assignments from UI-safe messages, technical diagnostics and structured details.
requiredActions: Forge passes only primitive diagnostics and may rely on CatalogFailure redaction as a final boundary
Lumen displays CatalogDiagnostics rather than raw Error objects
Sentinel adds credential-shaped failure payloads to browser and architecture gates

events.summary: Froze the final catalog-native cross-agent export surface, replaced image URLs with catalog image keys, aligned lossless enum naming and restored the untouched Helix block.
requiredActions: Forge imports these domain types, projects productId/displayName/nutrition/unitEvidence/imageReference losslessly, emits resultIndex as zero-based SQLite order, and never builds an image URL inside SQLite projection
Helix consumes CatalogProduct.nutrition and CatalogProduct.unitEvidence and uses unitKind/source values exactly as frozen without aliases
Lumen consumes CatalogStatus and CatalogDiagnostics, composes optional image URLs only from CatalogProduct.code plus CatalogImageReference outside the projection, and never receives raw Error objects
Sentinel enforces the exact export names and enum values, rejects imageUrl/url in CatalogProduct projection, and verifies slotStates plus activeSlot single authority
No agent adds API/OFF compatibility aliases or adapters

events.summary: Closed the catalog failure redaction boundary, removed raw cause retention, redacted complete Authorization and Cookie header values, and removed unused CatalogCountability from the frozen export surface.
requiredActions: Forge, Helix, Lumen and Sentinel use consumer baseline commit 977d426c52f8e0ee586926b88aaba5c1b0f3c07d for Atlas-owned exports
No consumer imports or recreates CatalogCountability as a product-authority field; countability remains resolver-local derived behavior
Forge and Lumen never expose a raw cause or raw Error object across the catalog boundary
Sentinel tests complete multi-token header redaction and absence of a public cause property
No agent adds API/OFF compatibility aliases or adapters
